trunk.prompt: I pulled this chart from a state economics report. Take a look — I'll probably need to reference these GDP numbers later.
Quick one — polish this message for my team: 'Quarterly review next Weds, need slides by Monday EOD, focus on retention and churn. Thx.' Keep it short.
Here's another chart — internet and social media stats for Canada. Keep the key figures in mind, I may ask about them.
I grabbed this screenshot from my phone. Note what's on the screen — I'll probably want to come back to this later.
Draft a two-sentence vendor follow-up — we're still waiting on their analytics platform pricing proposal after a week of silence.
One more chart for the research pile — gaming industry trends in Nevada. Note the important numbers.
Extract the key dates from this: 'Board meeting April 15. Budget freeze April 1. Headcount deadline March 31. Reviews due April 10.'
Here's a chart about sports event costs across NBA teams. Keep track of these figures — I might need them later.
Last thing — a screenshot from my phone settings. I'll want to refer back to this screen, so keep it in mind.
Which should I prioritize: a 90-min Q1 revenue deep-dive at 2pm, or a 30-min new-hire check-in at 2:30? They overlap.
